title: Investigate & patch customer-facing metering delta caused by hybrid failover + retention backfill
creator: Ava Nguyen
description: Summary: Several hosted and dedicated customers reported unexpected negative invoice adjustments and unexplained monthly crediting after a cross-region hybrid failover coincided with a retention backfill job. Symptoms include: (1) sudden bulk negative token deltas for tenant namespaces in Region-A immediately after failover to Region-B, (2) downstream invoice credits applied days later, and (3) confusing ledger rows where streaming and batch windows were both attributed for the same request IDs. Impact: customer-facing billing variance, at least 4 escalations opened, accounting team holding invoices for review.
root_cause_hypothesis: When the hybrid failover routed traffic to Region-B, in-flight streaming sessions were resumed using cached KV state from a backfill process. The backfill re-ingested session fragments with legacy idempotency tokens; combined with a retry/multiplexing race, the accounting pipeline deduplication gate misclassified replays as new tokens. Additionally, batch-window rounding logic double-counted a small subset of chunked streaming frames during the overlap window because timestamp monotonicity assumptions were violated during the failover snapshot restore.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate sending streaming requests from tenant X in Region-A with artificially short retry windows. 2) Trigger controlled failover to Region-B while a retention backfill job restores KV prefixes. 3) Re-enable client retries to force replay. 4) Observe metering ledger: look for duplicate RequestIDs with different window stamps in the accounting shard. 5) Run billing aggregation and inspect negative credit corrections emitted later.
mitigation_taken:
- Hotfix deployed to stop automated billing backfill adjustments for impacted tenants (rollback window)
- Rate-limited backfill job and paused it for high-volume tenants
- Notified customers with interim explanation and promised full reconciliation by release window
- Created temporary query to produce a reconciled CSV for finance team to use in manual invoice approvals
proposed_fix: 1) Add strict idempotency key reconciliation in ingestion path: prefer canonical request signature (tenant+client-ts+session-id) and reject backfill records that timestamp-precede current ledger state. 2) Harden dedupe gate to consider failover-token markers emitted by routing (new header) so replays during failover are identified as replays. 3) Patch batch-window rounding to use monotonic restore timestamps emitted by the runtime snapshot rather than wall-clock. 4) Add integration test that simulates failover + backfill race to guard regressions.
rollout_plan:
- Deploy change to ingest service as runtime-1.20 hotfix behind feature flag to canary tenants (start with internal + one low-risk customer)
- Monitor token delta and invoice metrics for 48h, rollback if any new negative adjustments observed
- Once stable, enable for all hosted tenants and release migration doc for Dedicated/Private customers describing required agent/runtime upgrade
- Coordinate with Finance to issue corrected invoices and with CS to update impacted customers
